description: English locale for Qnbot CLI (phrase replacement based)

replacements.设置 Telemetry 运行时流开关，stream_id=0xF1/0x00: Set Telemetry runtime stream switch, stream_id=0xF1/0x00
replacements.获取设备数据 profile（当前固件通常返回 UNSUPPORTED）: Get device data profile (current firmware usually returns UNSUPPORTED)
replacements.启动引导式 IMU 磁力计校准: Start guided IMU magnetometer calibration wizard
replacements.获取全局 IMU 输出总开关状态: Get global IMU output master switch
replacements.设置全局 IMU 输出总开关，persist=0/1，默认 1: Set global IMU output master switch, persist=0/1, default 1
replacements.启动配对并等待终态: Start pairing and wait for terminal state
replacements.写入配对结果与对端设备名: Write pairing result and peer device name
replacements.力反馈定压测试（按 q 停止）: Force feedback fixed-pressure test (press q to stop)
replacements.扳机震感模拟（按 q 停止）: Trigger haptic simulation (press q to stop)
replacements.力反馈测试结束，已关闭输出。: Force feedback test ended, output disabled.
replacements.扳机震感模拟结束，已关闭输出。: Trigger haptic simulation ended, output disabled.
replacements.提示：按 q 可随时中断。: Tip: press q to interrupt at any time.
replacements.按 Enter 继续，按 q 退出。: Press Enter to continue, press q to exit.
replacements.步骤6/6：调参测试并再次试播: Step 6/6: Tune parameters and trial output again
replacements.按回车后会按顺序立即执行 enable/mode/timeout，并把固定强度: After pressing Enter, enable/mode/timeout will run immediately, then fixed strength 0~100 will be mapped to an internal pressure value and sent continuously for about 3 seconds.
replacements.开始固定反馈强度测试（约3秒），请留意当前强度是否容易感知。: Start fixed feedback strength test (~3s); please check whether the current strength is clearly perceptible.
replacements.固定反馈测试过程中出现超时次数: Timeout count during fixed feedback test
replacements.按回车后进入实时联动模式：扳机值超过阈值后开始反馈；按 q 可随时退出该模式。: After pressing Enter, realtime linked mode will start: feedback begins when trigger value exceeds the threshold; press q at any time to exit this mode.
replacements.说明：扳机值按 512~3584 映射为压力值；当 threshold 小于 5: Trigger values are mapped to pressure using 512~3584; when threshold is below 512, the actual start point still remains 512.
replacements.当前设备不支持 haptics.* 命令（请使用 help 查看可用命令）。: Current device does not support haptics.* commands (use help to view available commands).
replacements.提示：当前设备未开放 IMU 输出总开关命令（imu.output.*）。: Tip: Current device does not expose IMU output master switch commands (imu.output.*).
replacements.提示：当前设备未开放 Wireless 命令面（wl.*）。: Tip: Current device does not expose Wireless command plane (wl.*).
replacements.示例：wl.pair.start slave | wl.stream 1 | w: Example: wl.pair.start slave | wl.stream 1 | wl.push 4 (do not type []/<> from help text)
replacements.示例：enc.list | imu.list | stats（帮助中的 []/<: Example: enc.list | imu.list | stats (do not type []/<> from help text)
replacements.当前未检测到在线手柄，请先连接手柄，或显式指定 idx: No online handset detected. Connect handset first or specify idx explicitly
replacements.回车开始采样，q取消；采样中请保持当前姿态稳定。: Press Enter to start sampling, q to cancel; keep current posture stable while sampling.
replacements.采样失败：未获取到手柄数据，请检查遥测链路。: Sampling failed: no handset data received, please check telemetry link.
replacements.覆盖采样失败：未得到有效极值: Coverage sampling failed: no valid extrema obtained
replacements.扳机采样失败：未获取有效数据: Trigger sampling failed: no valid data received
replacements.步骤8/8：写入校准参数并结束校准。: Step 8/8: Write calibration parameters and finish calibration.
replacements.回车确认写入，q取消。: Press Enter to confirm write, q to cancel.
replacements.操作提示：请缓慢分别绕 X / Y / Z 三个轴旋转设备，覆盖尽量多方向。: Operation tip: slowly rotate the device around X / Y / Z axes to cover as many orientations as possible.
replacements.完成后按回车结束并保存（建议旋转至少 10~20 秒）。: Press Enter to finish and save (recommended rotation duration: 10~20 seconds).
replacements.检测到中断，正在尝试结束校准并保存。: Interrupt detected, trying to finish calibration and save.
Existing pairing process detected, trying to cancel previous process first...
Config mode detected, exiting config mode first...
replacements.开始轮询配对状态（按 q 可中止并发送取消）。: Start polling pairing status (press q to abort and send cancel).
Abort command received, canceling pairing process...
replacements.命令（请使用 help 查看可用命令）。: commands (use help to view available commands).
replacements.提示：按 q 直接退出（无需回车）: Tip: press q to exit immediately (no Enter required)
replacements.操作提示：已结束校准并保存数据。: Operation tip: calibration finished and data saved.
Tip: this response only indicates acceptance. Check final result with wl.status or wl.pair.wait.
replacements.未知命令，输入 help 查看可用命令。: Unknown command. Enter help to view available commands.
replacements.调试提示：已开启 --debug，可查看原始 QnTP 帧输出。: Debug tip: --debug is enabled, raw QnTP frame output is available.
replacements.提示：端口可能被占用或不存在。请确认没有其它程序占用该串口。: Tip: port may be occupied or missing. Ensure no other program is using this serial port.
replacements.帮助中的 []/<> 不需要输入: []/<> in help are not typed literally
